verdicts.why: Storm is with the X-Men at the mansion (#17) and is summoned in #61. Her fights against the Red Skull (#62) and Doom (#63) go to a split stage.

value.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
value.text: Storm is among the X-Men who confront Spider-Man when he comes to the mansion seeking a cure. Later he summons her to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.

split.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
split.text: Storm fights on Spider-Man's team against the Red Skull and Doom.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Later joins Peter's team on the Beyonder's world.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Brings Storm to fight on the Beyonder's world.
